# AiChat

AI chat on a Frame: a floating action button at the bottom right of the Page opens chat as a popup; from there it moves to the Frame's Panel or to full screen. It takes the Frame's props and adds the chat. - The button is the one way in. It hides while chat is open in the Panel or full screen. - The mode is remembered for the tab in sessionStorage (and an open Panel). - Under 768 the popup is shown full screen. - `variant="storybook"` is the Storybook docs' chat: clear, move to Panel and close only, with no full screen and no more menu. - The conversation is kept in memory and moves with the mode. There is no history, and no backend: `respond(text)` returns the reply.

**Import:** `import { AiChat } from '@/components';`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `variant` | enum | `'app'` | `app` carries every header control; `storybook` carries clear, move to Panel and close. |
| `defaultMode` | oneOf | `'popup'` | The mode a tab with nothing remembered starts in. |
| `defaultOpen` | bool | `false` | Whether chat starts open when the tab has nothing remembered. |
| `storageKey` | string | `variant === 'storybook' ? `${AI_CHAT_STORAGE_KEY}-storybook` : AI_CHAT_STORAGE_KEY` | The sessionStorage key the mode is kept under (the Storybook variant has its own); null keeps nothing. |
| `onModeChange` | func | — | Called with the new mode whenever chat moves between popup, Panel and full screen. |
| `respond` | func | — | Returns the reply (or a promise of it) to a sent message. Without it nothing answers. |
| `starters` | arrayOf or shape or string or number | — | `{ id, label, text }` prompts offered while the conversation is empty. |
| `title` | string | `'AI chat'` | The chat's name: the header title, the button's label and the Panel landmark. |
| `panelLabel` | string | — | Overrides the Panel landmark's name; defaults to `title`. |
| `children` | node | — | The Page content. |

## Variants

**`variant`** — `app` · `storybook`

Anything not listed is not a valid value.
